author: opt-B3

contract.sync_assumed: caller separates consecutive calls that reuse the temp storage by a block barrier
contract.sync_performed: __syncthreads inside: 1 histogram init, 3 per radix pass (histogram, scan internal, state), 2 in the compaction (scan internal, buffer ready), 1 in the final emission (scan internal)
contract.k_range: [1, N) at run time, k == N unsupported
contract.n_range: N = 256 x IPT, IPT >= 1, N <= 32768 (16-bit index and count fields), measured 1024 to 32768
contract.type_constraints: fp32 and bf16 (fp16 has traits, outside the focus set), int32 indices derived from the blocked position
contract.nan_behavior: positive NaN orders above +inf and is selected first, negative NaN orders below -inf, never produced by focus-set inputs. -0.0 is normalized to +0.0 for ranking (fp32 through one FADD with +0.0, bf16 through a compare and select)
contract.tie_break_support: inherent: positions come from block scans in blocked order, the compacted candidates are in index order and the ties at the k-th key are ranked in index order, so prefer_smaller_index and prefer_larger_index run the same code as not_guaranteed
contract.sorted_output_support: not supported inherently, post-sort of k

correctness_notes: Every cell passed the full oracle battery for both requirements (random x4 seeds, tie_heavy, sorted_asc, sorted_desc, pivot_tie, all_equal, signed_zero, inf_denorm, quantized_random, relu_quantized). Final direct comparison of the best B3 configuration against B1_reference (not_guaranteed control for both requirements through --control-req) on all B3 cells, same lock section, the kill experiment of the idea card included (N 8192 k 64, both types).

low_level: Registers of the latency kernel at IPT 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128: bf16 32, 39, 63, 80, 128, 255 (B1 40, 48, 64, 128, 127, 255), fp32 40, 40, 79, 127, 255, 255 (B1 44, 48, 64, 128, 169, 255). Spills: bf16 96 bytes at N 16384 and 64 at N 32768 (B1 0), fp32 696 at N 32768 (B1 1024). Throughput occupancy: 6, 6, 6, 2, 2, 1 blocks per SM for bf16 against B1 8, 6, 4, 4, 2, 1 (the bf16 N 8192 kernel needs 103 registers for the predicated asm form, the loss of 2 blocks per SM is the 0.83x there), fp32 6, 5, 4, 2, 1, 1 against 6, 5, 4, 2, 1, 1.

Shared memory 3152 to 69712 bytes against B1 4256 to 147488 (candidate buffer of (N/1024 + 1) x 256 words of 4 or 8 bytes plus two 512-bin histograms from 16 or 32 items per thread, two 256-bin histograms below).

BAR.SYNC per latency kernel: 23 (bf16) and 35 (fp32) without compaction, 35 and 59 with, against B1 25 and 37. The compaction path executes 1 init, 3 per pass, 2 for the compaction and 1 for the final scan.
Canaries flat at 32.00 cycles and 3806 us at both ends of the batch.
algorithmic: Latency against B1 (bf16 then fp32): N 1024 k 16 1.00x and 0.94x, k 64 1.06x and 0.99x, N 2048 k 16 0.99x and 0.96x, k 1024 1.36x and 1.35x, N 4096 k 32 1.10x and 1.03x, k 256 1.33x and 1.33x, N 8192 k 64 1.05x and 1.15x, k 1024 1.75x and 1.87x, N 16384 k 64 0.94x and 1.16x, k 1024 1.61x and 1.79x, N 32768 k 256 1.20x and 1.37x, k 2048 1.82x and 2.00x. Throughput follows: 0.90x to 1.07x at small k below N 8192, 1.07x to 1.26x at small k for fp32 from N 8192, 1.16x to 1.76x at k >= N/16, 0.83x and 0.91x at bf16 N 8192 and 16384 small k (occupancy).

Where the gain comes from: at k >= N/16 the scan-based index-only emission replaces B1's k-dependent ticket pair epilogue (T29, 5k to 13k cycles at k 1024 to 2048) and from 16 (fp32) or 32 (bf16) items per thread the compaction after a 9-bit first pass removes two to three tile sweeps of the later passes (fp32) or one (bf16). At small k and small N nothing is saved and the extra barriers and the scan cost 0 to 6 percent against B1.

Kill experiment of the idea card, N 8192 k 64 random, same session: 1.051x (bf16) and 1.149x (fp32) in latency, 0.833x and 1.068x in throughput, below the 1.3x threshold. The card's own clause holds: confined to N 32768 and fp32 (1.366x at N 32768 k 256 fp32, 1.196x bf16) and to be merged into B1 as an option (the compaction from 16 or 32 items per thread with a 9-bit first digit, and the scan emission at every size).

prefer_smaller_index costs nothing: identical code path, 0.997x to 1.003x of not_guaranteed in every cell (the tie ranks come from the same packed scan in index order). bf16 inputs tie at the k-th key in every cell (1.4 to 32 keys equal to the k-th), so the deterministic rank is exercised there.

The fp32 advantage over bf16 at equal N and k (1.15x against 1.05x at N 8192 k 64, 1.37x against 1.20x at N 32768 k 256) is the pass count: fp32 saves two or three later tile sweeps by compaction, bf16 one.
negative: Compaction does not pay below 16 items per thread for fp32 or 32 for bf16, and at small k it never pays more than 1.37x at any N in the focus set: B1's later passes are cheap predicated sweeps, the card's model charged them as atomic sweeps.
bf16 at N 8192 and 16384 with small k loses in throughput (0.83x, 0.91x) through registers, the predicated asm store form should be reverted for 16-bit keys at 32 items per thread (T32).
N 1024 and 2048 at small k: 0.94x to 1.00x of B1 in latency and 0.90x to 0.97x in throughput, B3 has no business there, which PRIORITIES.md predicted.
surprises: The largest wins of the approach (1.6x to 2.0x at k >= N/16) do not need compaction at all below 32 items per thread, they are the emission. T21 shows B1's optimizer reaching an index-only ticket epilogue that keeps the k dependence, so the final evaluation should run B3_tuned against B1_idx, where the gap at large k should shrink to the ticket serialization (about one cycle per selected item).
open_questions: Compaction after an N6 first pass (T25: 1 to 7 candidates instead of 14 percent of N) would make the later passes free at every N, the natural combination of the two cards.

A striped candidate layout with a block-uniform slot count (ceil(c1/256) slots) instead of N/1024 per thread would cut the per-slot cost of the later passes at N 16384 and 32768, it needs a ballot-table tie rank to keep index order (report section 5).

The B1 reference pays 516 branch regions per call at IPT 64 for its filtered histogram atomics just as B3 does (T32), an unconditional atomic into a per-thread dummy word is the untested alternative for both.
